## Tiny Air Elemental (CR 1/2)

**XP** 200  

N Tiny outsider (air, elemental, extraplanar)  

**Init** +6; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +4  


**Defense**


**AC** 17, touch 14, flat-footed 15 (+2 Dex, +3 natural, +2 size)  

**hp** 11 (1d10+1)  

**Fort** +3, **Ref** +4, **Will** +0  

**Defensive Abilities** air mastery; Immune elemental traits  


**Offense**


**Speed** fly 60 ft. (perfect)  

**Melee** slam +6 (1d3+3)  

**Special Attacks** whirlwind (DC 10, 5-10 ft.)  

**Space / Reach** 0 ft./0 ft.  


**Statistics**


**Str** 10, **Dex** 16, **Con** 12, **Int** 4, **Wis** 11, **Cha** 11  

**Base Atk** +1; **CMB** +4 (Disarm, Sunder, Trip)/ +2 all others, **CMD** 12  

**Feats** Improved Initiative, Weapon Finesse  
*House rules: Weapon Finesse adds Dex instead of Str to finesse damage and CMB.*  

**Skills** Fly +19, Perception +4, Stealth +15  

**Languages** Auran  


**Special Abilities**



**Air Mastery (Ex)** Airborne creatures take a –1 penalty on attack and damage rolls against a tiny air elemental.  


**Ecology**



**Environment** Plane of Air  

**Organization** solitary, gang (5-8), enmasse (10-80)  

**Treasure** none
